profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer at Red Hat

positions.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
positions.description:
• Managed a team of managers overseeing 5 sub-teams consisting of 35+ engineers.  Primary responsibilities include:  training, mentoring, providing direct employee feedback, and hiring to grow the team based on business priorities.
• Led highly productive and successful geographically distributed teams include engineers in all US time zones, UK, Czech Republic, India, and China while being based in Rhode Island, USA.
• Founded and led a multidisciplinary team to build an AI-powered next-generation OpenShift web console, driving innovation in administrator & developer productivity and redefining platform interaction through intelligent automation.
• Frequently presented to leadership on new engineering software initiatives, team organization proposals.  Results included funding to launch a new Developer Productivity team of 5 engineers; approval to launch new projects to create features for console.redhat.com SaaS Platform.
• Spearheaded the design, formation of development team, and implementation of a company-wide developer portal for all engineering teams within Red Hat’s Service Delivery organization. Adoption included more than 500 engineers as stakeholders and users.
• Managed the budget process for AWS infrastructure across 10+ teams with an estimated budget of $1.5+ million annually.  Responsibilities included cost-savings effort which resulted in more than 20% decrease in cloud spend.
• Formed and led an engineering team to achieve the FedRAMP High certification for the Red Hat console.redhat.com SaaS Platform enabling Red Hat Insights to pursue federal contracts.

positions.title: Senior Manager, Technical Operations
positions.description:
• Managed TechOps team, including: setting team and individual goals; providing direct employee feedback, guidance, and training; and hiring to grow team from one to five engineers.
• Developed a CI/CD pipeline to allow engineers to deploy code seamlessly with no TechOps intervention using Jenkins and Github.
• Built a company-wide platform leveraging the latest DevOps methodologies such as infrastructure-as-code and configuration management to create version-controlled and repeatable environments using AWS CloudFormation, Chef, and Docker.
• Established processes for regular communication with all SocialCode teams, including Engineering, Customer Support, Business Development, and Finance, to understand and align the TechOps team with company-wide priorities.
• Designed and implemented cloud infrastructure utilizing autoscaling technology to ensure an enterprise level of system stability and resiliency.
• Established processes for receiving, prioritizing, and resolving customer service requests, allowing for a small TechOps team to support a company of more than 350.
• Coordinated with AWS personnel to establish an efficient working relationship, ensuring the quick resolution of AWS platform issues impacting SocialCode business goals.
• Adapted TechOps infrastructure and workflows during multiple acquisitions to ensure the smooth integration of incoming assets, software, and personnel.  
• Partnered with internal compliance team and outside vendors to lead SocialCode through Sarbanes-Oxley and SOC 2 Type 2 certification efforts, including establishing processes to streamline annual recertification.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and wrote a software package to build targeted voter models and automatically retrain the models as new data became available.
•  Overhauled Technology Team processes to entirely remove dependence on Oracle database.
•  Implemented a multi-terabyte person matching system using pgpool-II cluster software to allow for massive horizontal scale-out.
•  Planned and built Cassandra clusters capable of scaling from physical hardware into Amazon EC2.
•  Ported Geocoding system from PostgreSQL to Cassandra backend to improve processing throughput by a factor of 15.

positions.title: Database Administrator
positions.description:
•	Supported a replicated production environment of over 10 MySQL database servers including performance tuning, backups, monitoring, and upgrades with minimal customer downtime.
•	Implemented a daily incremental backup scheme for all MySQL databases.
•	Designed and built MongoDB clusters for high availability use.
•	Built a system to transport and archive data from MySQL into MongoDB.
•	Constructed scripts to allow third party data to integrate cleanly with Salsa data.
•	Diagnosed and resolved database performance issues quickly and efficiently.

positions.title: Technology Director
positions.description:
•	Administered Colorado VoteBuilder database including acquisition and loading of updated voter data.
•	Built targeted persuasion and GOTV universes for the 2010 Colorado Coordinated Campaign contributing to Michael Bennet’s election to the United States Senate.
•	Served as the primary contact to county parties and campaigns on technical questions regarding the effective use of the Colorado voter file.
•	Maintained Coordinated Campaign office infrastructure including the purchase and installation of new hardware and software.

positions.title: Systems/Database Administrator
positions.description:
•	Installed and maintained Linux servers running CentOS 5 and Oracle Enterprise Database 10g and 11g.
•	Created and implemented backup solutions for Oracle, PostgreSQL, and MySQL database systems.
•	Converted data warehouse from Oracle to Vertica which improved query run-time by a factor of 10.
•	Designed and built Hadoop clusters running HBase.
•	Engineered server and network infrastructure improvements.
•	Performed ticket-based remote and in-office technical support.
